name: Zone V · Scene 2: Pastoral — The White Sheep Glen & Roofed Steadings
greek: Ἐν δὲ νομὸν ποίησε περικλυτὸς Ἀμφιγυήεις ἐν καλῇ βήσσῃ μέγαν οἰῶν ἀργεννάων, σταθμούς τε κλισίας τε κατηρεφέας ἰδὲ σηκούς.
buckley: On it also the illustrious Vulcan formed a large pasture of white sheep, in a beautiful grove, and folds, and covered sheds and cottages.

worldModel.vision: Quiet emerald and olive-green valley (330/378) dotted with white sheep (15), stone pens (71), and dark-tan thatched cottages (28/70).
worldModel.memory: Stillness counterpoint: three compact Homeric hexameters of tranquil shelter immediately following the lion violence.
worldModel.controller: Architectural containment (σταθμοί, κλισίαι, σηκοί) keeping the flock safe in the wooded glen.

shots.name: In a Fair Wooded Glen
shots.beat: The famous Lame God fashions a great pasture of white-fleeced sheep in a fair wooded valley.

shots.name: Folds, Roofed Steadings & Shepherd Cottages
shots.beat: Stone folds, roofed steadings, and thatched shepherd huts shelter the quiet flock.
